# Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide() { *A mostly reasonable approach to JavaScript* > **Note**: this guide assumes you are using [Babel](https://babeljs.io), and requires that you use [babel-preset-airbnb](https://npmjs.com/babel-preset-airbnb) or the equivalent. It also assumes you are installing shims/polyfills in your app, with [airbnb-browser-shims](https://npmjs.com/airbnb-browser-shims) or the equivalent.
